tables.name: referral_campaign
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS referral_campaign (
 id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
 enabled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 friend_discount_paisa BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(friend_discount_paisa > 0),
 reward_paisa BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(reward_paisa > 0),
 minimum_subtotal_paisa BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(minimum_subtotal_paisa > friend_discount_paisa),
 return_window_days BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(return_window_days >= 7),
 updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables.name: referral_redemptions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS referral_redemptions (
 customer_id VARCHAR(191) PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
 referrer_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_accounts(user_id),
 order_id VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
 phone_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 reward_paisa BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(reward_paisa > 0),
 wait_days BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(wait_days >= 7),
 created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
 CHECK(customer_id <> referrer_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

tables.name: order_email_jobs

tables.name: review_photos

tables.name: review_replies

  `description_en` longtext NOT NULL,
  `description_ne` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `price_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `compare_at_price_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `inventory_quantity` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `producer` longtext NOT NULL,
  `country_of_origin` longtext NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `materials` longtext NOT NULL,
  `dimensions` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `care_instructions` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `safety_information` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `return_conditions` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `return_eligible` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `warranty` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `made_to_order` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `preparation_days` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  `manufactured_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `licence_reference` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `review_note` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_request_id` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `published_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `materials_json` longtext NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  `origin_story` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `origin_evidence_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified',
  `origin_evidence_reference` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `size` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `colour` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `variations` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `specifications` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_products_slug_unique` (`slug`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_products_seller_sku_unique` (`seller_id`,`sku`),
  KEY `idx_products_public_catalog` (`status`,`category_id`,`published_at`),
  KEY `idx_products_seller_status` (`seller_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_products_seller_updated` (`seller_id`,`updated_at`),

  KEY `idx_products_public_recent` (`status`,`published_at`),
  KEY `products_category_id_categories_id_fk` (`category_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `products_reviewed_by_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `products_seller_id_seller_profiles_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`seller_id`) REFERENCES `seller_profiles` (`id`) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `products_price_non_negative` CHECK (`price_paisa` >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT `products_compare_price_non_negative` CHECK (`compare_at_price_paisa` is null or `compare_at_price_paisa` >= 0),

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_refunds_return_request_unique` (`return_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_refunds_order` (`order_id`),
  KEY `idx_refunds_status_requested` (`status`,`requested_at`),
  KEY `refunds_payment_id_payments_id_fk` (`payment_id`),
  KEY `refunds_requested_by_users_id_fk` (`requested_by`),
  KEY `refunds_approved_by_users_id_fk` (`approved_by`),
  KEY `refunds_high_value_approved_by_users_id_fk` (`high_value_approved_by`),
  KEY `refunds_processed_by_users_id_fk` (`processed_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_approved_by_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`approved_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_high_value_approved_by_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`high_value_approved_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_order_id_orders_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_payment_id_payments_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`payment_id`) REFERENCES `payments` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_processed_by_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`processed_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_requested_by_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`requested_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_return_request_id_return_requests_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`return_request_id`) REFERENCES `return_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_amount_positive` CHECK (`amount_paisa` > 0),
  CONSTRAINT `refunds_components_valid` CHECK (`item_amount_paisa` is null or `item_amount_paisa` >= 0 and `delivery_amount_paisa` >= 0 and `item_amount_paisa` + `delivery_amount_paisa` = `amount_paisa`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `order_number` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `receipt_token_hash` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `operation_request_id` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `customer_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `customer_email` longtext NOT NULL,
  `customer_phone` longtext NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `locale` longtext NOT NULL,
  `currency` longtext NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NPR',
  `policy_version` longtext NOT NULL,
  `return_policy_snapshot_json` longtext NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"generalRequestWindowDays":7,"deliveryDamageEvidenceWindowHours":48,"changeOfMindEnabled":true,"highValueRefundThresholdPaisa":1000000,"refundInitiationBusinessDays":2,"codRefundEstimateBusinessDays":[3,7]}',
  `shipping_address_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `item_subtotal_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `seller_discount_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `delivery_charge_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `buyer_platform_fee_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `tax_total_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `grand_total_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `payment_mode` longtext NOT NULL,
  `payment_status` longtext NOT NULL,
  `placed_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `delivered_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `delivery_for` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'self',
  `recipient_email` varchar(254) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_address_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `address_saved_for_future` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `wallet_credit_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`wallet_credit_paisa` >= 0),
  `referral_discount_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`referral_discount_paisa` >= 0),
  `current_total_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_subtotal_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_delivery_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_wallet_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_discount_paisa` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `promo_discount_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`promo_discount_paisa` between 0 and 9007199254740991),
  `current_promo_discount_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`current_promo_discount_paisa` between 0 and 9007199254740991),
  `refunded_promo_discount_paisa` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (`refunded_promo_discount_paisa` between 0 and 9007199254740991),
  `promo_campaign_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `promo_revision` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `promo_code` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `promo_label` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `discount_source` varchar(16) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (case when `promo_discount_paisa` > 0 then 'promo' when `referral_discount_paisa` > 0 then 'referral' else 'none' end) VIRTUAL,
  `current_referral_discount_paisa` bigint(20) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (case when `current_discount_paisa` is null then `referral_discount_paisa` else `current_discount_paisa` - `current_promo_discount_paisa` end) VIRTUAL,
  `cancellation_version` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `delivery_rate_snapshot_json` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_orders_order_number_unique` (`order_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_orders_receipt_token_unique` (`receipt_token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_orders_customer_created` (`customer_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_orders_status_created` (`status`,`created_at`),
  KEY `orders_promo_campaign_fk` (`promo_campaign_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `orders_customer_id_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
  CONSTRAINT `orders_promo_campaign_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`promo_campaign_id`) REFERENCES `promo_campaigns` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `orders_money_non_negative` CHECK (`item_subtotal_paisa` >= 0 and `seller_discount_paisa` >= 0 and `delivery_charge_paisa` >= 0 and `buyer_platform_fee_paisa` >= 0 and `tax_total_paisa` >= 0 and `grand_total_paisa` >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cancellation_totals` CHECK (`current_total_paisa` is null and `current_subtotal_paisa` is null and `current_delivery_paisa` is null and `current_wallet_paisa` is null and `current_discount_paisa` is null or `current_total_paisa` is not null and `current_total_paisa` >= 0 and `current_total_paisa` <= 9007199254740991 and `current_subtotal_paisa` is not null and `current_subtotal_paisa` >= 0 and `current_subtotal_paisa` <= 9007199254740991 and `current_delivery_paisa` is not null and `current_delivery_paisa` >= 0 and `current_delivery_paisa` <= 9007199254740991 and `current_wallet_paisa` is not null and `current_wallet_paisa` >= 0 and `current_wallet_paisa` <= 9007199254740991 and `current_discount_paisa` is not null and `current_discount_paisa` >= 0 and `current_discount_paisa` <= 9007199254740991 and `current_total_paisa` = `current_subtotal_paisa` + `current_delivery_paisa` - `current_wallet_paisa` - `current_discount_paisa`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
